# html's markup.list is one element whose tag is `ol` or `ul`, and a tag is a
# #[construct] prop: an element cannot change it once built. A list whose
# `ordered` reads state is rebuilt when that changes, written where it stands
# and as each copy of a loop over state; patched in place, the tag write was
# refused or reached nothing.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'
grep '<ul ' app.sngl.snapshots/state_before.html
! grep '<ol' app.sngl.snapshots/state_before.html
grep '<ol start="4"' app.sngl.snapshots/state_after.html
! grep '<ul' app.sngl.snapshots/state_after.html
grep '<ul ' app.sngl.snapshots/loop_before.html
grep '<ol start="2"' app.sngl.snapshots/loop_after.html
! grep '<ul' app.sngl.snapshots/loop_after.html

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import markup "sngl:ui/markup"
import test "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component byState ui.node {
    var numbered = false

    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #flip(text="flip", @click { numbered = !numbered })
        markup.list(ordered=numbered, start=4) {
            markup.listItem {
                markup.paragraph {
                    markup.text(value="item")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

struct L {
    ordered bool
}

component inLoop ui.node {
    var lists = [L{ordered=false}]

    ui.vbox {
        ui.button #flip(text="flip", @click { lists = [L{ordered=!lists[0].ordered}] })
        for var l = lists {
            markup.list(ordered=l.ordered, start=2) {
                markup.listItem {
                    markup.paragraph {
                        markup.text(value="item")
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

func testByState(t test.Test, c byState) {
    t.snapshot("state_before")
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("state_after")
}

func testInLoop(t test.Test, c inLoop) {
    t.snapshot("loop_before")
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("loop_after")
}
